definitions.explanation: A bath for soaking and washing, or the act of taking a bath. In Japan, bathing typically involves washing the body outside the tub before soaking in hot water.

examples.japanese: {風呂|ふろ}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{入|はい}る→入る：00494_hairu⟧。

⟦{仕事|しごと}→仕事：00480_shigoto⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{後|あと}→後：09580_ato⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦ゆっくり→ゆっくり：00910_yukkuri⟧お{風呂|ふろ}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{浸|つ}かる→浸かる：13290_tsukaru⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{一番|いちばん}→一番：01140_ichiban⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{楽|たの}しみ→楽しみ：01651_tanoshimi⟧だ。
examples.english: Soaking in the bath after work is my greatest pleasure.

notes:
Usually preceded by the polite prefix お as お{風呂|ふろ}, even in casual speech.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- お{風呂|ふろ}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{入|はい}る→入る：00494_hairu⟧ (take a bath)
- お{風呂|ふろ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{沸|わ}かす→沸かす：01105_wakasu⟧ (draw/heat a bath)
- お{風呂|ふろ}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{沸|わ}く→沸く：01122_waku⟧ (the bath is ready)
- お{風呂|ふろ}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{浸|つ}かる→浸かる：13290_tsukaru⟧ (soak in the bath)
- お{風呂|ふろ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{掃除|そうじ}→掃除：02889_souji⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧ (clean the bathtub)

In Japanese homes, the bathwater is shared by the family, so people wash and rinse outside the tub before soaking. ⟦{銭湯|せんとう}→銭湯：16032_sentou⟧ (public bathhouse) and ⟦{温泉|おんせん}→温泉：04117_onsen⟧ (hot spring) follow the same etiquette.
